externalSystems.label: Nordic synchronous area without Norway (Sweden, Finland, eastern Denmark)

winterPeak.derivation: Kinetic energy 256 GWs (Fingrid map, 2020-12-31 17–18) × remainder share 66.9 % (Norway 6.6 % NO4 + 26.5 % southern Norway) = 171 GWs. Load: non-coincident January 2026 peaks SE 24,965 + FI 15,553 + DK2 2,616 = 43,134 MW (coincident value probably 1–2 GW lower). FCR-N 600 MW over ±0.1 Hz and FCR-D 1450 MW up / 1400 MW down for the Nordic area (2026 SOA LFCR parameters); Norway's 2026 obligation share is 38 %, so the remainder holds 62 %: FCR-N 372 MW = 3720 MW/Hz, FCR-D up 899 MW (linear 49.9→49.5 Hz), FCR-D down 868 MW. aFRR: the Nordic 2026 volume of 200 MW each way (Appendix 1 to Annex LFCR 2026) less Norway's 31 % share = 138 MW.

summerLow.derivation: Kinetic energy: 2024 annual minimum 131 GWs × remainder share 77.0 % from the Fingrid map of the 2021-06-13 low-inertia hour = 101 GWs (the 2021 record low of 110 GWs gives 85 GWs). Load: SE+DK2 coincident summer-2025 minimum 10,154 MW + FI estimate 6,000–6,500 MW (Q3-2025 mean 8.15 GW × the 0.74–0.80 min/mean ratio of NO and SE) ≈ 16,400 MW. FCR-N 600 MW over ±0.1 Hz and FCR-D 1450 MW up / 1400 MW down for the Nordic area (2026 SOA LFCR parameters); Norway's 2026 obligation share is 38 %, so the remainder holds 62 %: FCR-N 372 MW = 3720 MW/Hz, FCR-D up 899 MW (linear 49.9→49.5 Hz), FCR-D down 868 MW. FFR up to 186 MW (62 % of about 300 MW) is procured only in low-inertia hours and is not included. aFRR: the Nordic 2026 volume of 200 MW each way (Appendix 1 to Annex LFCR 2026) less Norway's 31 % share = 138 MW.
